Announcement: SubZero-rs v0.4.0 Release — Stateless Amnesic Two-Way Optical Airgap Bitcoin Vault Appliance.

• COTS Over Honeypots: Airgap signing on generic commodity laptops.
• Stateless Optical Loop: Webcam PSBT QR ingestion (zbarcam) + animated BBQR signing.
• Substrate Hardened: Network and bluetooth kernel modules completely stripped.
• DRAM Remanence Protection: kexec into memtest86+ v8.10 actively scrubs all RAM before power cut.
• 5-Section Deep Ledger: Gap limit audits, offline address reuse, RFC 6979 nonce badge, USD converter.
• 100% Deterministic Reproducible Musl Build.
